title: Thomason structures in all strict categorical dimensions
exact_target: For every positive finite n and for strict infinity-categories, does the Thomason adjunction $c_n$ $Sd^{2}$ $\dashv $ $Ex^{2}$ $N_n$ supply a proper combinatorial model structure on strict n-categories with weak equivalences detected by the nerve, and a Quillen equivalence with the Kan–Quillen model category of simplicial sets?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
